direct_risk_subgraph_rationale: This subgraph is the minimal set of nodes required to represent the core structural issue. The analyst comment on bgb_558 alleges a 'non-curable enforcement conflict' with bgb_559, which is mediated by bgb_559a. conflicts.description: A structural conflict, identified by an analyst comment on bgb_558, arises from the incompatible ways these two sections handle public subsidies (defined in bgb_559a). bgb_559 excludes subsidies from the cost base for its cost-based increase. In contrast, bgb_558(5) subtracts an annualized value of the subsidy from a potential market-based rent increase. The comment alleges these two methods of passing the subsidy's benefit to the tenant represent 'opposite remedy classes' that create a 'non-curable enforcement conflict'.
